name: rdp_logons_from_internet
description: Successful Remote Desktop sign-ins on devices from public IP addresses, per device and source IP, with the accounts used. Finds RDP that is exposed to the internet.
query:
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{days}}d)
| where ActionType == "LogonSuccess" and LogonType == "RemoteInteractive"
| extend SourceIP = iff(RemoteIP startswith "::ffff:", substring(RemoteIP, 7), RemoteIP)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" or (RemoteIPType == "FourToSixMapping" and not(ipv4_is_private(SourceIP)) and not(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIP, "127.0.0.0/8")))
| summarize Logons = count(), Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 10), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by DeviceName, SourceIP
| order by Logons desc

name: process_runs_on_device
description: Every start of one program (file name) on one device with command line, account and parent process, newest first. Example for a parameterized custom hunt.
query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({{days}}d)
| where DeviceId =~ {{device}} or DeviceName =~ {{device}} or DeviceName startswith strcat({{device}}, ".")
| where FileName =~ {{file_name}}
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

device.description: Device name (short name or FQDN) or Defender device ID.
